Lightender

After Vry escapes, a human helps him face Megatroid, who has taken Vry's light and become Lightender.

Story role

Lightender follows Vry's escape from imprisonment. The human connection brings the conflict with Megatroid into the next chapter of the trilogy.

Read the trilogy timeline

Development target

Lightender is in active development using an Unreal Engine 4.23 HTML5 package target. Its guide and controls will describe that build separately from Dayfall.

UE 4.23 · HTML5
